verses.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.translation: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].[1577]
verses.footnotes: [1577]- This was a sign given by Allāh to Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) when the Quraysh challenged him to show them a miracle.

verses.arabic: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verses.translation: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."[1578]

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural
Verb — imperfect, subjunctive, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.translation: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.translation: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

verses.arabic: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَٰلِغَةٌ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
verses.translation: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller[1579] calls to something forbidding,
verses.footnotes: [1579]- Said to be an angel announcing the account and judgement.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
verses.translation: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

segments.description: Active participle — accusative, masculine, plural, indefinite
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.translation: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.translation: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.translation: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

verses.arabic: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
verses.translation: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

verses.arabic: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.translation: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَحَمَلْنَٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
verses.translation: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

verses.arabic: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.translation: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular
Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.[1580]
verses.footnotes: [1580]- To those after them, who were expected to derive a lesson from previous occurrences.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

verses.arabic: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
verses.translation: Extracting the people[1581] as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, feminine, singular

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: Thamūd denied the warning.

verses.arabic: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.translation: And said, "Is it one human being[1582] among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

verses.arabic: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
verses.translation: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

segments.description: Verb — perfect, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive

verses.arabic: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.translation: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.translation: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.[1583]
verses.footnotes: [1583]- This and the following verse are an address to Ṣāliḥ (upon him be peace).

verses.arabic: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verses.translation: And inform them that the water is shared between them,[1584] each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
verses.footnotes: [1584]- i.e., between the tribe of Thamūd and the she-camel - a day for each to drink.

verses.arabic: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.translation: But they called their companion,[1585] and he dared[1586] and hamstrung [her].
verses.footnotes:
[1585]- i.e., the worst and most despicable among them.
[1586]- Or "he took," referring to his sword or to the she-camel.

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: The people of Lot denied the warning.

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ نَّجَّيْنَٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

verses.arabic: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.translation: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.translation: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.translation: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

verses.arabic: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.translation: So taste My punishment and warning.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.translation: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

verses.arabic: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.translation: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

verses.arabic: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

verses.arabic: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verses.translation: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.translation: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].[1587]
verses.footnotes: [1587]- This foretold event took place on the day of Badr.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, singular, passive
Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.translation: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.[1588].

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.translation: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."[1589]
verses.footnotes: [1589]- One of the proper names of Hell.

segments.description: Verb — imperfect, indicative, 3rd person, masculine, plural, passive

verses.arabic: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.translation: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.translation: And We have already destroyed your kinds,[1590] so is there any who will remember?
verses.footnotes: [1590]- i.e., those similar to you in attitude and behavior when they rejected Allāh's messengers.

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.translation: And everything they did is in written records.

verses.arabic: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.translation: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verses.translation: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

verses.arabic: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.translation: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.[1591]
verses.footnotes: [1591]- Who accomplishes whatever He wills whenever He wills.
